name: Quantum Engraving #008 — Micro Cavity
description:
The sculpted architecture of photonics: an engraved conical micro-cavity reaching depths of over 200 micrometers within crystalline silicon. A visual testament to numerical moving-mesh mathematics (Arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian, ALE) with hyperelastic smoothing and steep sidewall taper angles (~85°).

Conceptually derived from Master's Thesis research in Nanophotonics and numerical simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics ('Modeling and implementation of laser engraving considering the impact of layers material', University of Tabriz). This artwork visualizes finite element mesh deformation and normal boundary recession velocity (vn = -Precoil + k_mesh).

Note: This artwork is an artistic interpretation inspired by multiphysics simulations and theoretical models; it does not claim to be a raw numerical export.
creator: Alireza Mahdipour Shadkam
